I used this assignment as an opportunity to update and streamline some inconsistencies in my websites design. For instance, my webpage for EPPS 6356 Data Visualization was only a landing page to send a website viewing to assignments and blogs associated with the class. This was updated for the webpage to act as a dashboard for the class the way all other webpages for classes were. My Resume and CV were updated, and a webpage set up for this class, EPPS 6302 Methods of Data Collection and Production.

Additional, I updated my website’s theme while keeping Lux as the underlying framework, shifting the design toward a lighter visual style inspired by the graphic on my homepage. I now use `#e8f1ff` as the primary background, `#000409` for most text and links, and `#000000` for headings, emphasis, and hover states. White is used selectively for cards, dropdowns, code blocks, tables, and form elements to create subtle contrast without breaking the overall palette. I also updated the navbar, footer, buttons, DataTables, callouts, and other interface elements so the site feels more consistent, while preserving the animated homepage hero and improving responsiveness for embedded content.

This was all done to keep a consistent brand through the websites entire layout that would survive long after graduation.
